newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia hoists Helsinki to all-time high close.
newsitem.headline: Nokia hoists Helsinki to all-time high close.

text.p: Shares ended at all-time highs on the main indices, as telecom bluechip Nokia racked up gains on a reaffirmed "buy" recommendation from U.S. investment bank Merrill Lynch, brokers said.
The FOX stock futures index gained 0.7 percent to end at a life-high 1,081.12, scraping past its previous May 27 peak by just a point.
The all-share HEX index rose 1.07 percent to a life-high 3,142.92 points, topping its previous record by almost 20 points.
"This looks very positive," one broker said after Nokia tilted upwards and Wall Street stocks opened higher.
Nokia advanced 11.50 markka to close at a new life-high 363.50, after touching 364.00 in lively trade, with volume in both the A and K-series shares mounting to 520 million markka.

Nokia was boosted by a reaffirmed "buy" recommendation from U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch, brokers said. A similar Merrill buy recommendation for Nokia's Swedish rival Ericsson sent that share higher on the Stockholm bourse.
Nokia's less-traded K share was unusually active, with volume in the K series over 250 million markka as some investors switched between the A and K shares, brokers said.
Brokers said talk of possible pulp price hikes by U.S. producers had rekindled foreign interest in Finnish forestries.
UPM-Kymmene rose 2.00 markka to 124.00, Enso gained 0.80 to 49.00 and Metsa-Serla closed up 0.30 at 41.60, in sturdy volumes for all three forestry shares.
Brokers said that, on balance, interim reports from Neste, Kesko, Metra, Orion and Rautaruukki had been a mixed bag.

Oil and energy group Neste ended down 1.50 markka at 136.00, but a session low of 131.00, after it reported four-month profits below analysts' expectations in a Reuters poll. But volume was thin at just 1.8 million markka.
Retailer Kesko fell 2.00 markka at 75.50 in sturdy 15 million markka volume after it reported four-month earnings below forecasts.
Pharmaceuticals group Orion ended unchanged at 205.00 markka after reporting in-line four-month profits.
Steel-maker Rautaruukki rose 0.90 markka 49.90 to after its four-month earnings came in slightly above the median of forecasts in a Reuters poll.

Engineering group Metra fell 2.00 markka to 145.50 in lively 22 million markka dealings after it reported January-April profits down at the low end of forecasts, but said it expected full-year earnings to improve on last year.
